architecture: Hierarchical Two-Stage Cash-Out Routing & Pairwise Cluster Ranking

stage_1_district_model.objective: Predict probability distribution over 11 Delhi revenue districts
stage_1_district_model.leakage_protection: 5-Fold Out-of-Fold (OOF) cross-validation on TRAIN. Test/Val uses TRAIN-fitted model.

hierarchical_features.name: candidate_district_probability
hierarchical_features.description: Posterior probability of the candidate cluster's revenue district from Stage 1 district model

hierarchical_features.name: candidate_district_rank
hierarchical_features.description: Rank (1..11) of the candidate cluster's revenue district by predicted probability

hierarchical_features.name: candidate_in_top2_predicted_districts
hierarchical_features.description: Binary flag indicating if candidate cluster's district is in Top-2 predicted districts

hierarchical_features.name: candidate_in_top3_predicted_districts
hierarchical_features.description: Binary flag indicating if candidate cluster's district is in Top-3 predicted districts

hierarchical_features.name: smoothed_fraud_district_cluster_prior
hierarchical_features.description: Laplace-smoothed empirical historical probability P(cluster | fraud_type, victim_district) computed on prior training history

hierarchical_features.name: smoothed_terminal_district_cluster_prior
hierarchical_features.description: Flag/prior indicating whether candidate cluster resides in the terminal mule account's district
